# SwiftTab — QR Table Ordering & Kitchen Display for Indian Restaurants

> SwiftTab is a B2B restaurant software platform offering QR table ordering, live kitchen display systems (KDS), waiter request routing, and car-side drive-in ordering for restaurants across India.

## Key Facts & Product Specs
- **Pricing**: ₹999/month flat rate (No per-order commission, no revenue percentage).
- **Customer Experience**: QR code scan opens digital menu instantly in any mobile browser. No app download, no account registration required.
- **Kitchen Operations**: Real-time WebSocket kitchen display system (KDS) with sound alerts and status tracking (Received -> Preparing -> Ready -> Served).
- **Payments**: Direct UPI QR & Cash payments. Restaurant collects 100% of money directly.
- **Hardware**: Runs on any smartphone, tablet, laptop, or desktop browser. Supports browser thermal receipt printing.
- **Support Contact**: Email `support@justswifttab.com` | WhatsApp `+91 97177468` | Website `https://justswifttab.com`
